papgi is a PDF editor and toolbox that runs entirely in your browser. Your files are never uploaded: opening, editing, converting and text recognition all happen on this device, and it works offline once loaded.
papgi reads the page images and adds their words as hidden text, so you can select, search, highlight and edit them. It all happens on this device.
